chunks.rationale: Start here: the new module-level pref (getter/setter/useSyncExternalStore hook) is what both UI sides share. Module state is the source of truth; localStorage only persists it across launches, so private mode still toggles.
risks: Lazy init caches the first read; an external localStorage edit mid-session is not picked up (acceptable — nothing else writes this key).

chunks.rationale: Consumer side: the card returns null when disabled, and the peer-peek effect bails early so no sibling thread is fetched while hidden. Hook is called unconditionally before existing early returns.
risks: The effect dependency array gained `enabled`; re-enabling re-runs the peek, which is the desired behaviour.

chunks.rationale: Producer side: a small gitCard with a checkbox in the Environment tab, rendered after ChangesCard so it also appears for remote projects. checkboxLabel css copied from MemoryTab's idiom.
risks: Placement is outside the remoteHost branch on purpose — the divergence card renders for remote threads too.

chunks.rationale: One test: toggle off hides the card and performs zero peeks; finally-block restores the module-level pref so test order stays independent.

risks: Preference is renderer-local (localStorage), not in AppSettings — it does not sync across machines and does not appear in the Settings modal. Chosen to avoid IPC/store plumbing for a UI-only visibility flag.
